acceptance_criteria: Pinned source, E1 environment, approved proposal/card, registry and all frozen tool hashes match before RUNNING.
All 120 predeclared candidates are evaluated; no seed is appended, replaced or selected after observing results.
Every retained parent has all requested tunnels, one connected finite graph/spline bundle, required cycle rank/length/vertical span and exact same-seed replay.
Each of ten strata retains its first ten machine-valid candidates and exactly 100 parents form an 80/10/10 parent-disjoint split.
All 100 canonical identities are unique; at least 40 coordinate-free WL hashes exist overall and at least three per stratum.
At least 70 retained parents contain degree>=3 structural events and all 50 3D retained parents have vertical span>=5 m.
Exactly ten maps visualize accepted rank-1 train parents only; validation/development-test are not human-selected or reviewed during generation.
Mesh, anchor, LiDAR, ray, teacher-label, formal-dataset, training, model, trajectory and M-TARE counts remain zero.
Required manifests, candidate outcomes, log, summary, immutable RUN_STATE and SHA-256 evidence complete within 2 hours and 2 GiB.
baseline: The passed five-topology pilot uses five explicit project templates with seed-jittered coordinates and therefore cannot serve as a 100-independent-topology source; native Cano random grown/connector generation is the approved replacement candidate source.

estimated_cost.compute: Frozen E1 CPU; at most 120 native-random topology constructions plus 120 same-seed graph-only replays; no mesh, raycasting, GPU, simulator or training.

expected_evidence: Frozen source/tool/environment/approval identities, exact command, raw log, duration, exit code, RUN_STATE and evidence SHA-256
All 120 per-candidate outcomes and generation return records plus graph/spline artifacts for every generated candidate
Accepted 100-parent manifest, parent-level 80/10/10 split manifest, replay, canonical identity, WL diversity and structural distribution metrics
Ten complete X-Y/X-Z maps selected only as accepted rank-1 train parent per frozen stratum
method: Evaluate all 120 predeclared candidate seeds in ten frozen strata using pinned Cano add_random_grown_tunnel/add_random_connector_tunnel through a read-only audited adapter. Each requested tunnel gets one bounded 100-trial API call and every return is recorded. Reconstruct every successfully generated candidate once with the same seed, retain the first ten machine-valid candidates per stratum, assign accepted ranks 1-8/9/10 to train/validation/development-test, audit canonical and coordinate-free WL diversity, and render only the first accepted train parent per stratum. Flat strata additionally zero grown vertical tendency/noise because upstream TunnelNetworkParams.flat only affects connectors. Generate no mesh, LiDAR, label or model.
question: Can pinned Cano random grown/connector generation produce 100 valid, replayable and structurally diverse topology parents across tree/loop/scale/flat/3D strata, instead of 100 seed-jittered copies of five templates?
stop_conditions: Any approval, source, environment, hash, registry, scope or output-state mismatch
Any source/system/schema failure that prevents completing the predeclared candidate audit
Any stratum has fewer than ten valid candidates, replay/split/diversity criteria fail, or continuation requires appended seeds, lowered thresholds or five-template reuse
The run exceeds 7200 seconds or 2 GiB

user_authorization.confirmation_reference: 用户在收到120 candidate、100 topology parent、80/10/10 parent split、topology-only且零mesh/LiDAR/训练的精确范围后回复：批准
user_authorization.scope: One topology-only audit of 120 predeclared candidates across 10 strata, retaining exactly 100 by frozen first-valid rules and freezing an 80/10/10 parent split; zero mesh, LiDAR, labels and training.
